## Scope and design

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results, plus any limitations.

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are met.
- [ ] Relevant automated and manual checks passed (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Cached content changes include a cache-version bump and updated asset list where needed, or this does not apply.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] New apps or major direction changes have project-lead approval, or this does not apply.
